g.text: Reject unknown prefixes and invalid structure.
Block modifying commands if startup loading failed.
The following path assumes loading succeeded.
Find the actual Person by normalised Student ID.
If absent, throw CommandException without saving.
Lock, write temporary JSON, check external changes,
Existing records and filter remain unchanged.
Retain it after saving only if records changed (maximum 100 snapshots).
Close any displayed attendance report on success.
On failure, preserve undo history and the displayed report.
Map external changes, another writer, storage location,
and general I/O failures to their respective error messages.
